tasks.instruction: The fixture has three explicit source_logs events and starts with the clock paused. Keep it paused while configuring, then use clock controls or the Interview Workbench advance action for scheduled work.
Create Minute errors on sh01, owner admin, app search, with search=index=source_logs status=500 | stats count, earliest=-1m@m, latest=@m, schedule=* * * * *. Keep summary indexing off.
Advance the simulation across its first minute boundary. Inspect the successful scheduled run and scheduler.log or an _internal scheduler search.
